title: Kilobot
description: Documented public swarm robot platform (Harvard (Rubenstein, Nagpal)) for the Swarm Behavior Designer capability area.
body:
Kilobot is a documented swarm robot platform from Harvard (Rubenstein, Nagpal). The 1,024-robot Kilobot swarm demonstrating thousand-robot self-assembly and collective behaviors on a tabletop.

How it works: It works by stepping a small flock with a cohesion rule pulling each agent toward the centroid, then measuring the mean distance to the centroid.

Documented uses of this capability area include warehouse automation fleets, surgical robotics, autonomous laboratories, drone delivery networks, and subsea exploration.
